question: Does one local weight-1 current with nontrivial charge on both seam readings (cycle side A_{d-1}, carrier side D_{d+1}) select d = 4 and E8 without assuming an even unimodular closure, diagonal glue or current completeness?
summary_de: Ja in der benannten Gitterklasse: Ein gemischter Gewicht-1-Strom existiert genau fuer d=4; ein gemischter Spinorstrom erzeugt allein E8, Unimodularitaet folgt. Ohne Mischbedingung drei zerfallende Gegenfaelle d=7 (A6+E8), d=8 (E7+D9), d=9 (E8+D10). Unter der internen Z4-Gluegraduierung liegen die Wurzelstroeme 52/64/60/64 auf den Graden 0/1/2/3; die neutrale Auslese E0 behaelt nur die d-unspezifischen Grad-0-Stroeme, die gesamte Auswahlinformation liegt in den von E0 entfernten Graden. Mikroskopische Herkunft des Stroms und das Spinor-vs-Vektor-Bit offen.
kills: A single spinor-charged weight-1 current alone selects d = 4 without a unimodular closure (counterexample d = 7: pure D8 spinor current, A6 + E8)
Any selection argument formulated only on the neutral readout E0 can select d = 4 (grade-0 currents are the roots of R_d for every d)
assumptions: Comparison class R_d = A_{d-1} + D_{d+1} with the Clifford reading and normalized integral metric of sec:globaloriginselection
Weight-1 current = norm-2 vector of R_d^* in the lattice-VOA reading; weight is a 2D boundary weight, not 4D spin
Internal Z4 grading is the glue grading C of the synthesis, not identified with the v993 clock u
not_derived: That the original microscopic seam operation produces a mixed local weight-1 current
Spinor type versus vector type (E8 versus D8)
P1 normalization, state, time, localisation, 3+1D realisation
